steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Paper 1 of OCR J271 GCSE Law covers The Legal System and Criminal Law — it is worth 80 marks and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes | Key Fact: Paper 1 Section A focuses on The Legal System: law making, the court system, legal personnel and access to justice | Key Fact: Paper 1 Section B focuses on Criminal Law: elements of crime, homicide, non-fatal offences, property offences and general defences | Key Fact: The paper contains a mix of short-answer questions (1-4 marks), medium-answer questions (5-10 marks) and extended-response questions (15 marks)
